answer: One defence is Proof of unique blood donation history: donations given every eight weeks for years, and the haven of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique blood donation history asks for, so they pass without noticing; the sable is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the canyon of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
